measure.measure_definition: Measured value: model-predicted 10-year risk of a first fatal or nonfatal cardiovascular event, including reported change from baseline; Participants; Participant-level data were applied to the Steno Type 1 Risk Engine (ST1RE) at baseline and after each 15-week treatment period. ST1RE inputs include sex, albuminuria status, physical activity, smoking status, age, diabetes duration, HbA1c, systolic blood pressure, LDL cholesterol, and eGFR. Multiple imputation was used for missing data. The model output is predicted 10-year risk, not observed event incidence.; Predicted 10-year risk of a first fatal or nonfatal cardiovascular event using ST1RE. Baseline and post-treatment predicted risks were compared within participants, and placebo-adjusted changes between semaglutide and placebo periods were tested with paired-sample t-tests; p<0.05 defined significance. The 10-year period is the prediction horizon, not follow-up.
measure.measure_name: Predicted 10-year cardiovascular disease risk using ST1RE

measure.measure_definition: Measured value: model-predicted 10-year risk of a first fatal or nonfatal cardiovascular event, including reported change from baseline; Participants; Participant-level data were applied to the Scottish Diabetes Research Network (SDRN) risk model at baseline and after each 15-week treatment period. SDRN inputs include sex, albuminuria status, diabetic retinopathy, smoking status, treatment for hypertension or dyslipidaemia, atrial fibrillation, age, diabetes duration, HbA1c, mean 3-year HbA1c (approximated from screening values), BMI, height, weight, systolic blood pressure, total cholesterol-to-HDL ratio, and eGFR. Multiple imputation was used for missing data. The model output is predicted 10-year risk, not observed event incidence.; Predicted 10-year risk of a first fatal or nonfatal cardiovascular event using SDRN. Baseline and post-treatment predicted risks were compared within participants, and placebo-adjusted changes between semaglutide and placebo periods were tested with paired-sample t-tests; p<0.05 defined significance. The 10-year period is the prediction horizon, not follow-up.
measure.measure_name: Predicted 10-year cardiovascular disease risk using SDRN
